context: Yumiko shows Hina-young her vegetable garden.
purpose: Grandmother sharing gardening with teen niece.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひな、見て、トマト赤くなった!
lines.en: Hina, look — the tomatoes have turned red!
lines.style: Warm opening, almost conspiratorial delight. Soft proud tone. Inviting her to share the moment. Slight lift on the exclamation, like she's been waiting to show her this.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Genuine awe, unguarded. Bright and open. The voice of a child who has just seen something grow and connected it to her own hands. Small gasp of wonder on the opening.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 土、いいから、よく育つの。
lines.en: The soil here is good — that's why they grow so well.
lines.style: Quiet teacher's voice, not lecturing. Pride in the care she's taken. Matter-of-fact kindness. Pause before the second clause, letting Hina land on the cause and effect herself.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Will you help me harvest them?
lines.style: Eager and reaching. Brightens on the question. The voice asking not just for hands but for continued attention and togetherness. Open, hopeful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Thank you — that makes me really happy.
lines.style: Tender, genuine gratitude. Soft and steady. The voice of someone who feels seen. Not performing emotion, but letting it settle in the space between them. Slight warmth on the final word.
